Views

Views used to display and manage news content.

news.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow an editor to approve an article.

news.views.article_create(request)[source]

Allow a journalist to create an article.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]

Display one approved article.

news.views.article_list(request)[source]

Display all approved articles.

news.views.article_update(request, pk)[source]

Allow an authorised user to update an article.

news.views.editor_articles(request)[source]

Show independent and affiliated publisher articles to editors.

news.views.login_view(request)[source]

Log in a user with their username and password.

news.views.logout_view(request)[source]

Log out the current user.

news.views.my_articles(request)[source]

Show articles written by the current journalist.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]

Allow editors and journalists to create newsletters.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]

Show a newsletter and its approved articles.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

Show newsletters that contain at least one approved article.

news.views.newsletter_update(request, pk)[source]

Allow an editor or the original journalist to edit a newsletter.

news.views.register(request)[source]

Register and log in a new user.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]

Allow a Reader to manage their subscriptions.
